insights.statement: Users who buy dairy products online are blocked by the inability to assess the freshness and quality of the products, leading to frequent instances of receiving spoiled or curdled milk. This issue is exacerbated by the lack of clear return and refund policies.
insights.mechanism: The mechanism behind this behavior is the lack of trust in the quality of the products and the uncertainty surrounding the return process, which prevents users from exploring new categories and leads to dissatisfaction with their purchases.
insights.so_what: This is a trust and quality control problem, not just a matter of improving the return policy. To address this, the platform needs to implement robust quality control measures and provide clear information about the products, including their freshness and return policies.
insights.caveat: The evidence is based on quotes from users who have had negative experiences with dairy products, which may not be representative of all users.
